questions.question: _______ is an organization representing the entire cooperative movement in India.

questions.question: The Second Anglo-Mysore War ended with the signing of which of the following treaties?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Treaty Of Mangalore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Treaty Of Mangalore:-**

 
 
• It was signed in 1784 between the British East India Company and Tipu Sultan, the ruler of Mysore.
 
• **The treaty ended the Second Anglo-Mysore War, which was fought between 1780 and 1784.**
 
• The treaty allowed Tipu Sultan to keep his territories, but he had to pay a large indemnity to the British.
 
• The treaty also included provisions for prisoner exchange and the return of captured territories.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Treaty of Madras:-**

 
 
• The Treaty of Madras was a peace agreement signed on April 4, 1769, to end the First Anglo-Mysore War. Here's a breakdown of its key points:
 
• **Parties Involved**:
 
 
• 
 
**Mysore:** Ruled by Hyder Ali at the time.

 **British East India Company**: Represented by Lord Harry Verelst.

 
 
• 
 
**Purpose: **To formally end the war that had been ongoing since 1767.

 
 
• 
 
**Key Terms:** **Exchange of Territories**: Both sides agreed to return the territories they had captured during the war.

 **Mutual Assistance: **The treaty included a clause stating that the British would assist Mysore if attacked by its neighbors. This clause became a point of contention later.

 Significance:

 
The Treaty of Madras was a temporary truce. Hyder Ali felt the British didn't uphold their promise of assistance when Mysore faced the Marathas in 1771. This contributed to renewed conflict and the later Anglo-Mysore Wars.

 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Treaty of Wandiwash:-**
 
 
• It was signed in 1760 between the British East India Company and the French East India Company.
 
• The treaty ended the Third Carnatic War, which was fought between 1756 and 1763.
 
• The treaty allowed the British to establish their dominance in southern India and marked the beginning of the decline of French influence in India.
 
• The treaty also included provisions for prisoner exchange and the return of captured territories.

questions.question: The Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Amendment Bill 2022 has amended in _____.

options.text: Weapons, Hazardous Chemicals and Destruction Act, 2010
Prohibition of Dangerous Weapons of Mass Destruction Act, 2014
Prohibition of Biochemical Mass Destruction Act, 2007
Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005.**__

• **The Bill was introduced in the Lok Sabha on April 5, 2022, and was passed by both houses of Parliament with a voice vote.**
 
• The Act amends the Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005, to:
 
 
• Prohibit the financing of any activity related to weapons of mass destruction (WMDs) and their delivery systems.
 
• Empower the government to seize, freeze, or attach the economic resources and financial assets of those engaged in prohibited activities.
 
• Provide for integrated legal measures to control the export of materials, equipment, and technologies related to WMDs and their delivery systems.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect regarding microfinance?

questions.question: The **price of wheat in flour **can be included in the _______ method of measuring national income.

• **Value added method:-**

 
 
• **The value-added method is an economic measure that calculates the national income by adding the value added at each stage of production. **
 
• In the case of wheat, the value added would be the difference between the price of the wheat and the price of the flour.
 
• This difference represents the value that was added by the milling process.
 
• **The price of wheat 
into flour is a part of the value added method of measuring national income. **

questions.question: When were the Fundamental Duties first included in the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1976**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fundamental Duties:-**

 
 
• **The Fundamental Duties were first included in the Indian Constitution in 1976. This was through the 42nd Constitutional Amendment, which was enacted during the Emergency period.**
 
• The amendment added ten Fundamental Duties to Part IV-A of the Constitution. These duties were considered to be complementary to the Fundamental Rights, which had been included in the Constitution at its inception in 1950.
 
• The Fundamental Duties are intended to remind citizens of their obligations to the nation and to each other. They are not legally enforceable, but they are considered to be important moral and ethical principles.
 
• The 86th Constitutional Amendment, enacted in 2002, added another Fundamental Duty, bringing the total to eleven.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The eleven Fundamental Duties of Indian citizens:**

 
 
• Abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem.
 
• Honour the motherland and its rich heritage, culture and traditions.
 
• Promote harmony and national integration and the respect for different religions, languages and cultures.
 
• Render selfless service to the country and to put nation above self.
 
• Protect public property and abjure violence.

questions.question: Nongkrem festival of Meghalaya is celebrated by which of the following tribes?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Khasi tribe.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nongkrem:-**

 
 
• **It is a popular harvest festival celebrated by the Khasi tribe in Meghalaya.**
 
• The festival is observed in the month of November and is dedicated to the Goddess Ka Blei Synshar for a good harvest and prosperity.
 
• During the festival, traditional dances are performed, and sacrifices are made to appease the deity.
 
• The festival is also an occasion for the Khasi people to showcase their culture and traditional attire.

questions.question: Which chemical compound is used as a food preservative in some sauces and syrups, which retains their natural color and protects them from bacteria?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Potassium meta bisulphite.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Potassium meta bisulphite:-**

 
 
• **It is commonly used as a food preservative and a food additive.**
 
• It helps to maintain the natural color of the food and prevents the growth of bacteria.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monosodium glutamate:-**

 
 
• It is a flavor enhancer that is commonly used in Chinese cuisine.
 
 
 
• **Dihydroxy benzene:-**
 
 
• It is also known as resorcinol and is used in the manufacturing of dyes, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics.
 
 
 
• **Hydrazine hydrate:-**
 
 
• It is a colorless liquid that is used as a rocket propellant and in the production of polymers and pharmaceuticals.
